answer: A horizon thread stops fakes: an agent's thread of work must span a thirty-day horizon, one client-signed job etched in shale in each of three ten-day windows. A bid above ten units needs the full thread; two peers check each etching with the client within a day. A forged etching, an empty window, or a shared thread burns a 16-unit bond. Honest agents spin their thread toward the horizon; 100 fakes need 300 real jobs and risk 1,600 units.
